scope: Post-user-restart verification of fragmented Present candidate; runtime activation succeeded, targeted throughput acceptance failed.

completed_untraced_probe.instrumentation: No atrace/simpleperf/dumpsys during measurement; only endpoint CPU counters.

interrupted_long_probe.note: Incomplete 3000-frame attempt, interrupted by subprocess timeout. Interior buffered timestamps are retained; no success marker and no complete-run throughput claim.

prior_reference.comparison_limit: Historical reference only: background desktop/window composition and client load differ after restart. This is not a controlled old/new APK A/B and does not establish that this patch caused the lower observed throughput.

diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only. Trace and simpleperf were enabled together for attribution; its probe throughput is not a normal-use FPS sample.

conclusion.activation: Both independent X server and Android renderer executable APK mappings hash to the installed candidate 7f13f30e...; the old mixed state is resolved.
conclusion.hardware: Probe reported Mali-G925-Immortalis, completed 600 frames with the success marker and exit 0; both server and renderer map vendor Mali EGL.
conclusion.target: Not met: the complete untraced 600-frame probe averaged 43.73 submissions/s, median frame interval 25.07 ms, P95 38.04 ms. These are client probe timestamps, not physical screen new-content FPS.
conclusion.fallback: 214 CopyFallback.4.25.0 events were captured from the new server; all sampled fallback events rejected a final region with 25 rectangles, exceeding LORIE_GPU_COPY_MAX_RECTS=16. No reason 1/2/3/5 fallback events were observed in this bounded trace.
conclusion.patch_limit: Widening damage to the complete visible source does not bound the clipList intersection to 16 rectangles. The retained safe CPU fallback is still exercised in the observed window configuration.
conclusion.cpu: In the separate diagnostic recording, pixman_composite_src_8888_8888_asm_neon accounted for 81.65 percent of sampled X server CPU cycles. This is a CPU sample share, not CPU utilization or whole-device power.
conclusion.safety: No desktop/server restart, zink launch, software fallback, cursor movement or system service changes were performed. Tracing was stopped; tracing_on=0 and atrace tags=0 were verified.
conclusion.unverified: Popup/IME/pixel/resize acceptance was not expanded after throughput failure. No power, input latency or long-term stability conclusions.

next_step: Correct support for visible regions larger than 16 rectangles while preserving all clip holes, buffer ownership/fences and queue semantics. Do not use an unclipped bounding box over popup/IME windows. Build and test any further change separately; no further deployment/restart was performed in this check.
